# relay_private_endpoint (Data Source)

Reads an endpoint registered on a private endpoint service, by ID or by VPC endpoint ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_private_endpoint" "app" {
  workspace_id    = data.relay_workspace.prod.id
  service_id      = data.relay_private_endpoint_service.use1.id
  vpc_endpoint_id = "vpce-0123456789abcdef0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) Service the endpoint is registered on.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace to look in.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Endpoint ID.
- `vpc_endpoint_id` (String) AWS interface VPC endpoint ID.

### Read-Only

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider.
- `connection_status` (String) Connection status.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `dns_name` (String) DNS name the endpoint's hostnames point at.
- `error_message` (String) Why the connection failed, when it did.
- `index` (Number) Index in the endpoint's hostnames.
- `region` (String) Cloud region.
